text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-4829 for tenant 'acme-ux' (dedicated pool). Symptoms: sustained p95/p99 latency spikes, increased 503s, and reserved capacity throttling detected. Dashboard: <https://dashboards.redwood/inference/tenants/acme-ux|tenant dashboard>

Jamie (oncall): acked. I’m on it — ping me if you need escalation. :eyes:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4829 acknowledged by Jamie (oncall). Current escalation: oncall -> infra -> ops-lead.

Marta (infra): looking at the pool metrics — queue depth for acme-ux GPUs jumped ~3x at 12:03 UTC, autoscaler didn't kick (min/max config looks wrong). Also seeing API rate bursts from a customer job.

Li (runtime): I can see KV-cache evictions and a few worker processes in D state on node-5, plus steady 503s coming from the routing layer when capacity exhausted. Logs: `ERROR serve: allocate failed: reserved capacity exceeded`

Jamie (oncall): plan: 1) temporarily increase reserved capacity for acme-ux by +2 GPUs 2) enable fallback routing to shared pool for non-SLA routes 3) recycle stuck worker(s). If step 1/2 don't improve in 10m escalate to OpsLead.

Marta (infra): running scale command now —

```
# increase reserved pool for tenant
rictl reserved-scale --tenant acme-ux --add-gpus 2 --reason "auto-mitigation PD-4829"
```

Marta (infra): done. API returned queued jobs moved to new allocs. Provisioning shows two new nodes initializing (g4dn.xlarge). ETA ~2m.

Li (runtime): I'll restart worker on node-5 to clear stuck KV state. Doing controlled restart of model-worker-17. Command:
```
systemctl restart redwood-model-worker@17
```

Li (runtime): restarted. Observing healthy streams, tailing logs: `healthcheck: ready` on worker-17.

Jamie (oncall): enabling routing fallback for non-critical routes to shared pool (leaves SLA pinned traffic on reserved). Command:
```
rictl route-update --tenant acme-ux --fallback shared-pool --exclude-tags "vip"
```

Marta (infra): fallback enabled. Traffic started draining to shared-pool. p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 650ms within ~90s. p99 still elevated at ~2.2s.

Sophie (sales-eng): pinged account team + Beth to draft a customer note if the blip persists. Beth, can you standby for a short message?

Beth (CS): on it — holding a short note: "We're aware of elevated latency for some requests; mitigation is in progress and we will follow up with a timeline." Will wait for final status before sending.

OpsLead: good mitigation steps. Keep me posted. If p99 doesn't drop under 1s in next 10m escalate to full incident (notify SRE and infra on-call).

Jamie (oncall): monitoring. Current metrics: p95 620ms, p99 1.9s, 503s trending down but still ~0.6% of requests. Error logs show a couple of long-running customer jobs ramping capacity usage.

Li (runtime): additional note — the autoscaler had a bug where the scale decision ignored queued-only metrics for dedicated pools. I can push a quick toggle to use queue-depth until we patch. Would that be OK?

Marta (infra): yes please toggle. Command I can run to flip the flag:
```
rictl feature-flag set autoscaler.consider_queued=true --target reserved-pools
```

Marta (infra): flag flipped. Autoscaler evaluation triggered; additional workers allocated for acme-ux. Observing more steady capacity. p99 now 980ms and 503s ~0.15%.

Jamie (oncall): looks stabilizing. Keeping pages throttled to non-critical while we verify for 20m. No customer-facing message yet until stable for 30m or if they ask.

Sophie (sales-eng): account team updated — they requested ETA. Replying: "Mitigation applied, service is recovering; we'll confirm when within normal latency and follow up with postmortem."

OpsLead: please create a follow-up ticket for root-cause: autoscaler logic + reserved-pool config mismatch + long-running customer job patterns. Assign to infra/runtime.

Jamie (oncall): created ticket INF-2107 with action items and links to logs/dashboards. Handoff note for night: watch p99 and autoscaler flag state; re-run `rictl reserved-scale --tenant acme-ux --trim-gpus -2` after 2h if stable to return baseline.

Li (runtime): adding runtime mitigation PR to ensure KV cache eviction backpressure is handled gracefully. Will link PR in the ticket.

incident-bot: PD-4829 auto-resolved (no active page) after 25m. Resolution: temporary capacity increase + autoscaler flag toggle + worker restart.

Jamie (oncall): closing thread here. Will follow up in INF-2107 with timeline for permanent fix and customer comms draft. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Beth (CS): preparing post-incident note for account and will coordinate with Sophie.

OpsLead: good job. Postmortem required. Assigning SLO/regression check to QA.

Jamie (oncall): last_message: confirmed stable 45m after mitigation.
